name: Kotae –  automate customer inquiries for your website with AI chatbot
author: Tokyo Techies

sections.description:
Kotae is a smart Chatbot for small businesses. It will help response, manage, and analyze customer inquires for your small business\’s website.
This plugin will help add Kotae chatbot into your wordpress and user will have access to Kotae Chatbox where user can start inquiring about website.

External Dependencies

This plugin interacts with external services provided by Kotae AI. Here are the details:

  1. Resources Used:

    • Kotae Embed Script: A JavaScript file (index.min.js) for integrating AI functionality into your WordPress site.
    • Kotae Embed Stylesheet: A CSS file (index.min.css) for styling the embedded components.

  2. Servers Being Called:

    • https://kotae.ai/embed/index.min.js: The JavaScript script library for embedding chatbot functionality.
    • https://kotae.ai/embed/index.min.css: The stylesheet for styling the components.

  3. Account Requirements:

    • An active Kotae AI account is required to access and utilize the full range of services. You can create an account at https://kotae.ai.
    • Chatbot Id is needed for installation process. These can be obtained from your Kotae account dashboard.

Privacy and Data Usage

This plugin does not collect or store any data directly. However, it does load resources from external servers. Users are advised to review Kotae AI’s Privacy Policy for details about how their data is handled when interacting with the external services.
sections.installation:
1. Install Kotae – AI Chatbot Plugin for WordPress plugin by uploading the kotae-chatbot directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory. (See instructions on how to install a WordPress plugin.)
  2. Activate Kotae – AI Chatbot Plugin for WordPress plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Copy ChatbotId from your Kotae dashboard and paste into placeholder inside WordPress Plugin
